title: Report the template each pad is linked to
summary: Shows how to find the pad/via template behind each pad with FindLinkedBoardTemplate, read its library and template IDs, group pads by template, and create and link a board template from a pad.
phrasings: which pad via template is a pad using
list pad templates used on a board
link a pad to a pad stack template
get the library ID of a pad template

commands.name: GetTemplateName
commands.description: Report the pad/via template each pad is linked to
commands.params: Max=<number of linked pads listed, default 50> (optional)

commands.name: LinkTestPadTemplate
commands.description: Create a board template from a pad and link the pad to it (test setup)
commands.params: Pad=<pin descriptor, e.g. U1-1> (optional; default: first unlinked pad)
